title: Eurostat SDG 11.5.2: premature deaths due to PM2.5 exposure, Italy (annual, JSON-stat)
summary: Annual national statistic of premature deaths attributed to exposure to fine particulate matter (PM2.5) for Italy (geo=IT only), delivered as a JSON-stat 2.0 cube from the Eurostat dissemination API. Two units are present (NR = number of deaths, RT = rate). The cube has 18 time points and 36 cells, all populated with no status flags. It is national context only: no city, district, hourly or clinic-level detail.

quality_notes: Coverage vs windows: the cube's last year is 2023. It has no data for the production window (2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31). Its first year (2005) covers only one annual point inside the prototype window (2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04).

Time series gap: the time list runs 2005, 2007, 2008 ... 2023. 2006 is absent from the time dimension, so the series has 18 years rather than 19. Not flagged as missing cells; noted from the time values.
Units: two units (NR and RT) are in one cube. The rate's denominator is not stated in the summary, so counts and rates must not be mixed.
No methodology, model or confidence information was available in the tool outputs (no wiki or catalog entry was checked; this is a dataset link, not an internal source).
Refresh: last update 2025-12-09 per the JSON-stat 'updated' field. Refresh cadence is not stated.
